title: A memory's summary reads a location, a template with or without a body, and a composite's location part by their text form
notes: A location, a template with a body, a template without one and a composite of a text and a location are stored before the three questions, which push the compacting memory past its budget: the summarizer reads the older turns, each quoted after its role. A memory's summary, the exception among the readers outside a channel, reads every content of a message by its text form: the location as [Location: Office (45.5, -73.6)], a template by its body, else as [Template: reminder], the composite's parts in order, its location too. Python: memory/_summary.py summary_text (RMK-2241); roomkit-rs: roomkit-ai memory/summary.rs summary_text. Not observed: a rich text, read by its plain text; an edit, a delete and a tool call's row, which a room's ordinary context does not hand a memory, a tool call's row keeping its arguments and result; SummarizingMemory, which reads its lines the same way.
